subject: Hosted API eval follow-up: quickstart & deployment options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@finserve.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finserve.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API eval follow-up: quickstart & deployment options

Hi Sana / Tom —

Thanks for taking the demo today — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we showed
- Live demo of hosted API (text generation + embeddings) and per-route observability
- Example inference patterns: streaming chat for customer support, batch embeddings for search reindexing

Recommended next steps
1) Hosted API POC (fastest): we can spin up an evaluation org with API keys and a small credit bundle. This gets you endpoints + dashboard immediately.
2) If you outgrow hosted during the POC, upgrading to Dedicated capacity is straightforward (same API surface, different capacity tier).
3) Private VPC / on-prem is available for regulated deployments — longer lead time, requires contract + infra planning.

Hosted API quickstart notes
- API endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (and /v1/embeddings for vectors)
- Quick curl (POST /v1/generate) and SDKs (Python, Node) available in docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart
- Default rate limits: 60 requests/minute per API key for generation, and 120 requests/minute for small embeddings by default. We can raise these for an eval org.
- Token pricing and evaluation credits will be applied to the trial org; I’ve attached a short eval guide (redwood-hosted-eval-guide.pdf).

Security & compliance highlights (hosted)
- SOC 2 Type II in place; support for customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest on Dedicated/Private.
- Data residency for hosted: regional hosting options (us / eu) — let me know if you need specific EU-only residence for POC.

Attachments:
- redwood-hosted-eval-guide.pdf (quickstart + sandbox config)

Next actions
- If you want the eval org this week, I can provision it and loop Vivek (SE) to help with sample requests and rate-limit tuning.
- Please send the list of sample prompts/workloads you plan to run (or share a small dataset) so we can pre-tune batching/embedding settings.

Thanks — I’ll stand up the trial as soon as you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finserve.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval follow-up: quickstart & deployment options

Thanks Marissa — great demo. A couple of clarifying questions before we kick off the eval: 

1) Data residency: for PII we may need US-only hosting for now — is that supported for Hosted API trial?
2) SLA: what uptime SLA do you offer on hosted vs Dedicated? Our procurement team will ask.
3) Rate limits: for our embedding reindex we batch ~50K docs initially. Can you support higher throughput for embeddings during the POC (we were thinking ~2-3k reqs/min for batch jobs)?
4) Path to Dedicated / Private: if we want to move to Dedicated next quarter, what’s the rough procurement lead time?

Also — do you have an IP allowlist option and support for audit logs for the trial?

Appreciate the quick answers so we can get this into procurement.

— Sana
Sana Patel
Head of Search & ML | FinServe
sana.patel@finserve.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@finserve.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finserve.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API eval follow-up: quickstart & deployment options

Hi Sana — quick answers below, happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want more detail.

1) Data residency: yes — for Hosted API trials we can provision a US-only org (hosted in our US region). For EU-only we can do the same but needs to be specified up front.

2) SLA: Hosted API comes with a standard 99.9% uptime SLA; Dedicated can be contracted for 99.95%+ with reserved capacity SLAs. I’ve attached a short SLA draft for procurement to review (redwood-sla-draft.pdf).

3) Rate limits / embeddings: default hosted limits are conservative for multi-tenant safety, but for an eval we can bump the embedding throughput to support your initial reindex (we can target the 2-3k reqs/min window you mentioned). For sustained production at that volume we typically recommend Dedicated for predictable throughput.

4) Path to Dedicated / Private: Dedicated provisioning lead time is typically 4–8 weeks from contract signature (depends on GPU sizing and region). Private VPC/on-prem has a longer lead time (8–12+ weeks) and involves an onboarding project with our infra team.

Other security items:
- IP allowlist: available on Hosted (we can add the CIDR ranges you provide).
- Audit logs: available via the Console; extended retention is an add-on.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll provision a US-hosted eval org and raise the embedding rate limits for the POC.
- Vivek — can you note any specific benchmarks or test harnesses we should run during the trial?
- Neha — I’ll need a short quote for a 30-day eval bump to embedding throughput for procurement (we’ll make it a no-cost uplift inside the trial credit).

If that works I’ll provision the org today and send API key + sample curl.

Best,
Marissa

Vivek / Neha — forwarding the thread with FinServe. Quick asks so we can move fast: 

1) Provision a US-hosted eval org for FinServe (FinServe / RF-2026-042). Add 20,000 embed-requests/day quota for the first 14 days (aim to support their ~50K doc reindex across multiple batches).
2) Temporarily raise embeddings rate limit to 3k reqs/min for the trial window (monitor CPU/GPU throttling and back down if we see sustained issues).
3) Enable IP allowlist + audit-log collection for the org.
4) Vivek — can you prepare a short test checklist (3–4 benchmarks: 1k concurrent token streams, 3k embedding throughput, end-to-end latency targets) and be on the initial onboarding call?
5) Neha — please prepare a short internal note for procurement indicating this is a time-limited eval uplift (no charge) and approximate next-step pricing for Dedicated (ballpark monthly commit ranges).

I’ll draft the HubSpot activity and send the API key once we confirm provisioning.

Thanks — Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
